note: The first 4 sites are test sites: the *_rim_high and *_summit points are the highest pixel of the LOLA 80 m map near each feature (re-picked 2026-11-14 after a terrain-reading fix); they are NOT official site coordinates. The iau_* sites are the official IAU feature centre points (IAU/USGS Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature, MOON_nomenclature_center_pts, public domain; see data/README.md); for a crater the centre point is on the crater floor.
